sheet.name: Asterid Bivalacqua
sheet.backstory: A slender, sharp-tongued Jamaican-heritage Vodun hedge-wizard and avid gardener; an independent operator Nightingale has consulted since the 1950s.
sheet.magic_notes: and her magic is definitely non-Newtonian. If Nightingale knows what she's capable of

magic_spells.name: She's a woman of mysterious power
he isn't saying. Has an affinity for growing things

custom_fields.value: The burning taste of Scotch bonnet peppers and the fragrance of expensive rum on a warm summer's evening. Footnotes: 9 Night Witch, 10 Black Mould , 11 Action at a Distance
